idea-plugin.name: LeekBox
idea-plugin.description:
Track Chinese and Hong Kong stocks, exchange-traded ETF prices, intraday fund estimates, and domestic and overseas futures. Pin one quote to the status bar and share the watchlist across project windows.
在 Rider 原生侧栏查看 A 股、港股、场内 ETF 行情、基金盘中估值和国内外期货。 固定一个合约到状态栏，按交易时段更新行情。双击品种可打开 K 线，切换分钟、日、周周期，查看自定义均线和成交量。
